question: Which country will host the 2031 ODI Cricket World Cup ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India and Bangladesh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **2031 Cricket World Cup **will be** co-hosted by India and Bangladesh**.
 
• The decision was **announced by the International Cricket Council (ICC) **confirming the landmark event.
 
• This event is significant as it showcases the collaboration between two major cricketing nations in South Asia.
 
• Cricket is exceedingly **popular in both countries**, and jointly hosting the World Cup symbolizes their strong commitment towards promoting and developing the sport.
 
• It will also be an opportunity for these nations to showcase their unique** culture, hospitality, and the big strides** they have made in infrastructure and facilities necessary to host such a major global sporting event.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• International Cricket Council (ICC):

 
 
• The ICC is the global **governing body **for the sport of cricket.
 
• The organization was originally founded as the **'Imperial Cricket Conference' in 1909** by representatives from **Australia, England, and South Africa.** It was renamed to the **'International Cricket Conference' in 1965,** and then took its **current name in 1987.**
 
• The ICC’s main activities include governing cricket internationally, organizing international tours, competitions, and managing the rules, regulations, and equipment for the game.
 
• It is also responsible for the staging of all ICC Events, including the Cricket World Cup, among others.
 
• The ICC presides over the ICC** Code of Conduct, playing conditions, the Decision Review System, and other related matters.**
 
• The **headquarters of the ICC is in Dubai, United Arab Emirates**. It manages all operational matters from Dubai and administrates the game globally.
